events.t: Ponti antichi sul Tevere e sull'Aniene
events.n: drawn and engraved for the print series, published in 1836
events.q: The original artwork Ponte Mammea oggi Ponte Mammolo is an etching on copper, drawn and engraved by the artist Antonio Acquaroni (signed Aquaroni), for the print series Ponti antichi sul Tevere e sull'Aniene, published in 1836.
